mapper.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY E.statusDate DESC) AS seq, S.empId, S.empName, S.empNo, S.department, S.position, S.hireDate, E.status, E.empBirth, E.breakStart, E.breakEnd, E.statusReason, E.statusId FROM employee S JOIN employee_status E ON S.empNo = E.empNo
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee S JOIN employee_status E ON S.empNo = E.empNo
ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}

SELECT E.statusId, E.empName, E.empBirth, S.position, S.department, S.hireDate, S.empNo, E.status, E.breakStart, E.breakEnd, E.statusReason FROM employee S JOIN employee_status E ON S.empNo = E.empNo WHERE statusId = #{statusId}
